question: The 115th executive council meeting of the All-India Mayor Council was held on 15-16 June 2025 in which city?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Panchkula**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **115th Executive Council Meeting** of the **All-India Council of Mayors (AICM)** was held in the city of **Panchkula**, located in the state of **Haryana**.
 
• The meeting took place over two days, specifically on **15-16 June 2025**, and was attended by **Mayors** and municipal representatives from various parts of India.
 
• The event was hosted by the **Panchkula Municipal Corporation**, with **Mayor Kulbhushan Goyal** leading the local arrangements for the national-level gathering.
 
• The primary agenda of the **executive council** was to deliberate on the **financial health** of municipal bodies and to push for **greater administrative powers** for the office of the Mayor in India.
